# dotnet-pal-std-common

Dependency-free macro source for portable std services shared by desktop providers. No operating-system implementation; not an application entry point.

Part of the dotnet-pal-rs workspace. Core contracts live in `dotnet-pal-rs`;
platform implementations are separate dependencies. See the repository
`docs/crate-boundaries.md` for migration and supported qualification profiles.

# dotnet-pal-std

Compatibility facade selecting only the target OS provider. New platform-specific consumers can depend on dotnet-pal-linux-std, dotnet-pal-macos or dotnet-pal-windows directly.

Part of the dotnet-pal-rs workspace. Core contracts live in `dotnet-pal-rs`;
platform implementations are separate dependencies. See the repository
`docs/crate-boundaries.md` for migration and supported qualification profiles.

# dotnet-pal-storage

Portable no_std arena, backing ownership ledger and foreign storage hooks. Arena and hooks are explicit features. Wasm memory growth lives in dotnet-pal-wasm.

Part of the dotnet-pal-rs workspace. Core contracts live in `dotnet-pal-rs`;
platform implementations are separate dependencies. See the repository

text:
# dotnet-pal-wasip1

WASI Preview 1 clock, environment, entropy, identity and dispatch providers. Compose explicit storage separately. Only the wasm32-wasip1 target is implemented.

Part of the dotnet-pal-rs workspace. Core contracts live in `dotnet-pal-rs`;
platform implementations are separate dependencies. See the repository
`docs/crate-boundaries.md` for migration and supported qualification profiles.

# dotnet-pal-wasm

Single-owner wasm32 memory.grow storage for explicit composition with the PAL. Must not compete with another linear-memory allocator.

Part of the dotnet-pal-rs workspace. Core contracts live in `dotnet-pal-rs`;
platform implementations are separate dependencies. See the repository
`docs/crate-boundaries.md` for migration and supported qualification profiles.
